label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
output:
Right, here's the letter. Keep it civil but make sure they know you're not messing about.

---

**To whoever is using my bin at No. 14 Aughrim Terrace**

I don't know who you are, and honestly I don't care. What I care about is the fact that for the past month, my grey bin has been filled with bags of rubbish that aren't mine.

I'm with Greenmount Bins. I pay by weight. 0.41 per kilo. My last bill was €63.20 for two months. It's usually around €25. That extra €38 is your rubbish, not mine, and I'm not paying for it anymore.

Last Tuesday night I got home at 3am after a gig. The lid wouldn't even close. Three black bags in my bin that weren't mine. One of them had nappies in it. I found a gas bill envelope in another one, but the name was torn off. Just the terrace left on it. Convenient.

A neighbour saw a car pull up on Tuesday evening but didn't see who it was. So I know it's not a mystery. It's full bags, every week, for about a month now. This isn't a few bits falling in by accident.

If you're stuck and need to use someone's bin, ask. I'll tell you who to ring. It's not hard. But dumping your rubbish in my bin without a word is taking the piss.

I work nights. I'm not home half the time, and I'm not a pushover. Whoever this is needs to stop. Simple as that.

If it keeps going, I'll be locking the bin with a padlock. I'd rather not have to, but I will.

So do us all a favour and sort your own rubbish out.

**No. 14, Aughrim Terrace**
